Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That's it from the coverage of this game. The T20 World Cup action continues on Wednesday, 19 October 2022. Another double-header coming your way with Scotland taking on Ireland at 9.30 am IST (4 am GMT). Followed by a game between West Indies and Zimbabwe which will be played at 1.30 pm IST (8 am GMT). But as you all know you can join us early for the build-up. Until then, take care and goodbye!

Dasun Shanaka, the victorious skipper is in for a chat. He says that the crowd follows them and he is thankful to them for their support. Mentions that he is really disappointed with the way they ended the innings as they could have easily got to 180 or 190. Adds that he and Bhanuka Rajapaksa didn’t click in the middle overs and that cost them a few runs. Claims that coming into this game it was important to get the win and they didn’t worry about net run rate. Adds that they were able to put up a good score on the board and Dushmantha Chameera and Wanindu Hasaranga did well to restrict the opponents. Credits Pathum Nissanka for an outstanding innings and adds that he has always had the talent and they are proud of him. Ends by saying that hopefully everything will be fine with Dushmantha Chameera.

Chundangapoyil Rizwan, the skipper of United Arab Emirates says that they restricted the opponents to a decent total. Admits that they could have bowled better in the first half of the game but they did well to get back in match. Credits Karthik Meiyappan for bowling beautifully and adds that getting a Hat-trick in the World Cup is exceptional. Mentions that they usually play in hotter conditions but need to adapt to the different climates. Ends by saying that the batters could not get going as the Sri Lankan fast bowlers bowled well with the new ball and they need to work on their skill sets to do better.

Pathum Nissanka wins the Man of the Match award for his incredible knock of 74 runs. He says along with Kusal Mendis he was able to build a good opening partnership. Adds that all the other batters helped him build his innings. Claims that he is happy to play a game like this in the World Cup and thanks the crowd for their support.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the innings, Sri Lanka seemed to be on track to score around 180, although they could not keep the ante up and only posted 152 on the board. It was the brilliant effort of the UAE bowlers that helped them to pull things back. It was majorly because of Karthik Meiyappan who turned the game on its head with his Hat-Trick. Later though UAE could not turn on the heat with the blade and got bundled out for 73 runs.

Sri Lanka ripped the hearts of the UAE outfit. The bowlers never allowed the batters to have a breather at the crease. It was Dushmantha Chameera who opened the floodgates and boy, he was enjoying his time back from injury. Although, to break the hearts of Sri Lankan fans he was unable to complete his spell of 4 overs, as he went off the ground after picking up a niggle in his run-up. Hopefully, he should be back soon and it does not affect Sri Lanka's journey. Dushmantha Chameera was the star with 3 wickets. Wanindu Hasaranga and Maheesh Theekshana also did the trick with the ball and combined for 5 wickets.

United Arab Emirates could not turn up with the blade tonight. It looked like they will put up a solid fight with the way Chirag Suri started the innings, although things went bad very soon as they lost 4 wickets inside the Powerplay. Later, on only Aayan Khan played a gritty knock and Junaid Siddique entertained the crowd with his aggressive approach. Apart from them, no other batter could live up to the task.

Sri Lanka record their first win of the campaign in front of the buoyant Sri Lankan fans. United Arab Emirates tried their very best with the ball but the early collapse with the bat took the game away from them. Although there are a lot of sweet memories that UAE will take from this game.

OUT! CAUGHT! Maheesh Theekshana wraps up the game for Sri Lanka and celebrates the wicket in style with a bow and arrow celebration! This is bowled in line with the stumps on a fuller length, Junaid Siddique gets his front foot to the leg side and heaves the ball toward the leg side. He slices this to long on where Pathum Nissanka takes an easy catch and it fitting that he ends the game after his outstanding knock in the first inning. Sri Lanka have won by 79 runs and this has been a walk in the park for them.
Commentary.Howout: c Pathum Nissanka b Maheesh Theekshana

Commentary.Commentary: This is a fraction fuller and outside the off pole, Junaid Siddique pushes at the ball and gets an inside edge towards short fine leg for a single.
WIDE! Dasun Shanaka bowls a slower bouncer just outside off, Junaid Siddique is deceived by the pace but the umpire calls this wide for height.

OH NO! A huge blow for Sri Lanka. Their big man Dushmantha Chameera is struggling at the moment with an injury. He pulls out of his run-up and makes his way out of the field. The physio will surely have a closer look on the injury. Hopefully, it is nothing major.
Goes back to bowling on a good length and in line with the stumps Junaid Siddique looks to block this but gets an outside edge towards point.
Bowls this back of a length and outside off, Junaid Siddique slashes at the ball but does not connect as the ball goes through to the keeper.
This is on a good length and straight, Junaid Siddique looks to swing across the line but misses this time as the ball goes just over the stumps.

SIX! Junaid Siddique is not hanging around here! The ball has been dispatched out of the stadium for the longest six in the tournament so far! Dushmantha Chameera bowls this full on the pads, Junaid Siddique gets his front foot out of the way and plunders this over the deep square leg for a 109 meters biggie!

Dushmantha Chameera begins the over with a really full delivery in line with the stumps, Junaid Siddique digs this out past the mid off fielder and they take two runs as the fielder at long on cuts off the ball.
Bowls this one full and outside the off pole, Junaid Siddique drives this to deep cover for a single to retain strike.
This is on a shorter length as well and outside off, Junaid Siddique gets beaten on the outside edge as he pushes at the ball.

This is a fraction short and angled down leg, Junaid Siddique looks to pull but misses and the ball hits the pad. There is an appeal from the bowler but the umpire does not think this is out. Dasun Shanaka consults with his keeper and ends up taking the review at the last moment. UltraEdge confirms that there is no bat involved and Ball Tracking shows the ball is just clipping the leg pole on umpire's call. Junaid Siddique survives and United Arab Emirates bat on.
FOUR! That has been powered away! Maheesh Theekshana loops this full and outside off, Junaid Siddique gets his front foot out of the way and thumps the ball towards deep cover for a boundary.
A low full toss wide outside off, Zahoor Khan sweeps this towards deep mid-wicket and takes one.
Maheesh Theekshana bowls this full and just outside off, Junaid Siddique swings wildly and slices the ball past backward point for a single.
Zahoor Khan is the last batter for the United Arab Emirates.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Wanindu Hasaranga strikes this time. He deserved a wicket in this over, as he created several chances. It is tossed up, on off. Aayan Khan gets low and looks to sweep it away but misses. The ball goes through to rattle the stumps. A gritty innings from Khan comes to an end.

Junaid Siddique is living on the edge here. Full ball, on off. Junaid Siddique goes for the biggie yet again, although he doesn't get the desired distance on it. There is a miscommunication in the deep and eventually the ball lands safely yet again.
Short ball, on off. Khan pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On off, worked to covers.

DROPPED! It could've been 9 wickets but Jeffrey Vandersay spills it in the deep. It is full, in the slot. Junaid Siddique clears his front leg and pulls the trigger. It flies towards long on. Jeffrey Vandersay settles under it but could not pouch it.
Floated and full, outside off. Junaid Siddique gets it to the leg side off the inside edge.
Junaid Siddique is off the mark with a single. It is full and on off. Junaid Siddique throws his blade at it. The ball goes towards mid on but lands safely. The batters only take a single.
Junaid Siddique walks out to the crease.

OUT! STUMPED! Maheesh Theekshana finds the breakthrough. It is tossed up, on off. Karthik Meiyappan dances down the track and looks to go downtown but misses it completely. The ball goes through to the keeper who is quick to take the bails off. United Arab Emirates are now 8 wickets down.
Commentary.Howout: st Kusal Mendis b Maheesh Theekshana

Commentary.Commentary: Short ball, on off. Aayan Khan pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter, on off, defended out.
A single now as this full ball is driven to mid on.
It is looped up, on leg stump. Karthik Meiyappan steps across and tries to paddle it fine. He does not get a clean connection though.
Fuller, outside off. Khan guides it to backward point. The fielder there does well to dive and stop the ball from racing away.
Bit fortunate this time! A length ball, on off. Khan looks to clip it away but it a tad early into his shot. The ball takes the leading edge but lands short of the bowler.
FOUR! Nicely played! Back of a length, outside off. Aayan Khan stays back and cuts it over backward point and finds a boundary.
Karthik Meiyappan flicks this length ball off his pads and gets a single.
Shorter, wide of off. Aayan Khan stays back and cuts it to deep point for a single.
Full length, angled into the pads. Karthik Meiyappan flicks it to the leg side for one this time.
A single now as this is clipped towards mid-wicket.
Bowls this full and outside off gets the ball to keep its line, Karthik Meiyappan pushes at the ball but is beaten on the outside edge.
On off, defended back to the bowler.
Karthik Meiyappan makes his way out to the middle now.

OUT! LBW! Wanindu Hasaranga picks up his second wicket of the night. It is a googly, around middle. Kashif Daud swivels on the back foot and looks to pull it away but misses. He gets rapped on his pads and that looks quite plumb. Wanindu Hasaranga appeals and the umpire raises his finger in a flash. Kashif Daud does not even bother reviewing this has he makes the long walk back to the shed. Sri Lanka are now just three wickets away from a comprehensive win.
Fuller, on off. Khan gets down and sweeps it through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Khan cuts it to deep point off his back foot. They take a couple now.
A slower ball now, on a length, outside off. Daud taps it to point.
On off, defended out solidly.

In the air but safe! It is a short ball, on the body. Khan pulls it to deep square leg. There is a man in the deep but the ball falls over him. He does well to save a boundary though. Just a single then.
Good length, on top of off. Khan waits for it and blocks it out.
Good running! A length ball, on off. Khan throws his blade at it. The ball goes to covers. They take two runs.
Full length, on off. Khan dabs it out.
Googly at the stumps, Kashif Daud goes on the backfoot and defends. Another tidy over by Wanindu Hasaranga.

Drinks break! Sri Lanka are well and truly on top here. United Arab Emirates are teerting at 36/6 and their chances of securing a win here look impossible. United Arab Emirates need a miracle now if they are to get over the line. Sri Lanka will be hoping to end things as soon as possible. Kashif Daud is the new batter in for United Arab Emirates.

OUT! LBW! Wanindu Hasaranga strikes! Googly on the middle stump, Vriitya Aravind plants his foot forward to defend, the ball hits his pad first before the bat. A loud shout from the bowler and keeper, Rod Tucker, the umpire turns it down. Sri Lanka decide to go upstairs and the review does wonders for them as UltraEdge confirms that it is pad before bat. The Ball Tracking shows three reds and United Arab Emirates have lost their sixth wicket.
Flighted delivery on the off-stump, Vriitya Aravind drives it to cover.
Length delivery outside off, Vriitya Aravind gets forward and defends it to point.
Short and outside off, Aayan Khan rocks back and cuts it to deep point for a single.
Flighted delivery on the off-stump, Aayan Khan goes for the drive and gets an inside edge back onto his pad.
This is outside the off pole on a good length, Aayan Khan guides this to third man for a single and will keep strike. 5 runs and a wicket in this over.
Continues bowling short and outside off, Aayan Khan does not get hold of this one as well as he pulls the ball towards deep mid-wicket for couple of more runs.
This is bowled back of a length and outside off, Aayan Khan pulls this wide of deep square leg but not with great timing as he picks up a brace.
Bowls this a fraction full and outside the off stump, Aayan Khan blocks this towards cover.
Aayan Khan is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The captain brought himself on and has taken a wicket straight away! This is on a good length and angled into the pads, Basil Hameed looks to clip this leg side but gets a leading edge that loops into the air toward the mid-wicket fielder. Dhananjaya de Silva loses it initially but the ball is high enough for him to settle himself and take a comfortable catch. The United Arab Emirates have lost half their side now and Sri Lanka are right on top.
Commentary.Howout: c Dhananjaya de Silva b Dasun Shanaka

Commentary.Commentary: Dasun Shanaka begins with a good-length delivery outside off, Basil Hameed defends this towards point.
Flighted outside off, Vriitya Aravind taps it on the offside, Basil Hameed wants a single but is sent back halfway through. Wanindu Hasaranga starts off with a maiden.
Flatter on the off stump, Vriitya Aravind defends it on the offside.
Flighted delivery on the middle stump, Vriitya Aravind works it to mid-wicket.
Flighted on the leg stump, Vriitya Aravind clips it mid-wicket.
Flighted on the middle stump, Vriitya Aravind gets an inside edge that rolls to mid-wicket.
Flatter outside off, Vriitya Aravind pushes it to backward point.
Nails the yorker this time in line with the stumps, Basil Hameed gets his bat down in time and keeps the ball out.

Goes full this time and aims the ball at the middle stump, Vriitya Aravind dabs the ball towards mid on and takes a quick single. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end but replays show that Vriitya Aravind has made it beyond the crease comforatbly.
This is angled into the stumps on a good length, Vriitya Aravind clips this towards deep mid-wicket and they run well to take a couple of runs.

FOUR! There is no stopping this one as it has been swatted away! Bowls this back of a length and outside off, Vriitya Aravind times this beautifully as the ball races away to the deep point fence for a much-needed boundary.
This is on a good length and outside the off pole, Vriitya Aravind works this to the right of point but Wanindu Hasaranga dives and stops the ball really well.

Chamika Karunaratne starts off with a well-directed yorker in line with the stumps, Vriitya Aravind manages to dig this out towards the bowler. Some aggression from the bowler as he throws the ball back towards the batter.
Good length outside off, Basil Hameed defends it with a straight bat back to the bowler.
Full outside off, Basil Hameed goes for the drive and gets an inside edge that rolls to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Good length delivery outside off, Basil Hameed prods forward and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Basil Hameed is the new man at the crease.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Sri Lanka are ripping the heart of the UAE outfit here. Good length delivery on leg stump. Chirag Suri makes room looking to go inside out. The ball takes the outside edge of his bat and rattles into the stumps. Sri Lanka are on a roll here, UAE are now 4 down inside the Powerplay.
Good length delivery angled in to Chirag Suri who defends it back to mid-on.
Good length delivery on the off stump, keeps a bit low but Chirag Suri manages to keep it out.
Strays down leg this time on a really full length, Vriitya Aravind clips this to fine leg and takes a couple of runs to get off the mark.
Makes that five dot balls in the over. Dushmantha Chameera bowls this on a good length and outside the off pole. Vriitya Aravind is watchful as he blocks this out.
Bowls this back of a length and aims it at the body of the batter, Vriitya Aravind fends this towards mid-wicket. Four dot balls including a wicket so far.
Attacks the stump on a good length, Vriitya Aravind blocks this to the off side.
Vriitya Aravind comes in at number 5.

OUT! CAUGHT! Dushmantha Chameera gets his third and we can see why he was so eager to come back to bowl! This is a slower delivery served full and outside off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan is early into the shot as he lobs the ball into the air toward the cover fielder. Bhanuka Rajapaksa runs forward and takes a fine catch sliding ahead and United Arab Emirates are in some trouble now.
Commentary.Howout: c Bhanuka Rajapaksa b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: Dushmantha Chameera looks to be in fine rhythm here! This is bowled on a good length and outside off, Chundangapoyil Rizwan swings through the line of the ball but is beaten.
Good length delivery outside off, Chirag Suri looking to work it to third-man, the ball goes past the outside edge through to the keeper.
Short of a length delivery, Chirag Suri shuffles across to pull but gets beaten.
Half volley on the off stump, Chirag Suri drives it down the ground to mid off.
Full outside off, Chirag Suri drives it along the ground to cover.

Good length on the off stump, Chundangapoyil Rizwan taps it on the offside and sets off for a single. Chirag Suri isn't interested, the fielder throws at the strikers end and misses. The batsmen run on the overthrow.
Full down the legside, Chirag Suri flicks it to backward square leg for a single.
Chundangapoyil Rizwan is the new batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! Dushmantha Chameera has taken two wickets in one over and both times has seen the stumps disturbed! This is on a good length and in line with the leg stump, Aryan Lakra is cramped for room as he looks to play this and is beaten by the pace. The ball pegs the leg pole back and the United Arab Emirates have lost their second wicket. Sri Lanka taking control of the game now.
Dushmantha Chameera changing things up nicely as he bangs this in short and in line with the stumps, Aryan Lakra ducks under this one and lets the ball through to the keeper.
Goes back to bowling full and outside off, Chirag Suri knocks this wide of mid off and takes a run.
This is on a good length and outside off, Aryan Lakra guides this to third man and gets off the mark with a single.
Aryan Lakra is the new batter in.

OUT! BOWLED! Dushmantha Chameera draws first blood and Sri Lanka really needed this wicket early! This is bowled on a fuller length and wide outside off, Muhammad Waseem just swings his blade at the ball without any conviction and gets an inside edge that goes on to shatter the stumps. He reaches his 50th T20I wicket in the process and he looks elated.
FOUR! Rare poor delivery by Maheesh Theekshana! Floats it way down the legside, Chirag Suri helps it on its way behind square on the legside for a boundary.
FOUR! Rare poor delivery by Maheesh Theekshana! Floats it way down the leg side, Chirag Suri helps it on its way behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Short of a length delivery, Chirag Suri defends it off the back foot on the off side.
Slider onto the pads, Chirag Suri is beaten on the flick.
Fuller delivery on the leg-stump, Chirag Suri drives it back to the bowler.
Flighted delivery outside off, Chirag Suri makes room, goes for the drive and gets beaten. The keeper is quick to remove the bails. But the batter hasn't lifted his foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Muhammad Waseem clips it to the right of square leg for a single.
This is on a good length and outside off, Chirag Suri blocks this towards cover and that brings an end to an eventful over. 10 runs have come off it.
Goes full this time and gets the ball just over the tram line. Chirag Suri reaches for the ball but does not connect.

FOUR! Make that two in a row and this has been crunched! Pramod Madushan pulls his length back a fraction and outside off, Chirag Suri gets well on top of the bounce and slaps this to deep point for another boundary.

FOUR! United Arab Emirates living on the edge here! Chirag Suri is off the mark with a lucky boundary. Pramod Madushan serves this full and outside off, Chirag Suri plays all over this and gets a nick past the diving wicket-keeper to his right. The ball runs away to third msn for four runs and they have their first boundary.
WIDE! Bowls this one full and wide outside the off stump. This is beyond the tram line and the umpire calls this wide.
Another jaffa! This is on a good length and just outside off, Chirag Suri hangs his bat out to dry and gets beaten all ends up.

Pramod Madushan begins with a beauty! Gets the ball to swing away sharply from outside off on a good length, Muhammad Waseem plays at it and gets a thick edge that flies to the right of the first slip fidler. Dhananjaya de Silva gets a hand to it as the ball goes to third man for one.
